svg.text: Each bit is one symbol: the carrier frequency itself carries the bit.
· Example bit sequence 1 0 1 1 0 0 1 0 — one symbol per bit, no phase continuity requirement between symbols.
· Each symbol is shaped with a raised-cosine envelope, which keeps the transmitted spectrum compact.
· Configurations shown are the ones used in physical validation (15 / 16.5 kHz). The application defaults to 18.5 / 19.5 kHz.
· These frequencies are not universally optimal — they are the pair that worked on the test hardware. Run calibration to choose your own.
Gross symbol rate at 20 ms: 50 symbols/s = 50 bit/s before framing overhead. src/audio/bfskModem.ts
